items.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023
items.q: Greg Caputo’s good friend, that’s where I met Greg.

ctx.x: I have a quote for you from drummer Gregory Caputo, when he played with the Harry James band.

He said, “Fred having played with Harry James when Sonny Payne was playing the drums expected no less from me. I had to step-up my intensity and kick the band with the forcefulness of a Howitzer cannon.
